entries.name: key-0x80-present-errored#0
entries.script: { true }  // SELF ContextExtension carries key 0x80 (128): the signed-negative Byte makes toSigmaContext's `new Array(maxKey+1)` throw BEFORE any bytecode -> the spend FAILS. ergots/sigma-rust treat keys as unsigned 0..255 and ACCEPT — the consensus-fork divergence (the extension is attacker-supplied, so mainnet-reachable).

entries.name: key-0x7f-present-accept#1
entries.script: { true }  // SELF ContextExtension carries key 0x7f (127), the inclusive max: the context builds and the tree evals normally — the accept boundary, contrast to 0x80.

entries.name: getvar-0x80-absent-none#2
entries.script: { getVar[Int](0x80) }  // GetVar of id 0x80 with the key ABSENT (empty extension) -> None, no crash: the divergence is PURELY at context construction (key PRESENT), not at the read — clean None both sides.
